title: Review: jmap-mail-server pass 9
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — 3 correctness bugs, all in error handling paths (wrong validation type, missing validation, missing response field). No security surface or API design issues. Good news: 8 prior passes caught the hard stuff.
Idiom rating: CLEAN — No gratuitous clones, no unsafe, no unwrap in live paths, no Box<dyn Error> in API. The serde_json::to_value(...).expect(...) calls are infallible by construction (derived Serialize types) and are accompanied by invariant comments; this is the idiomatic approach. No meaningful idiom findings beyond opinion-level style.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: Email/copy onSuccessUpdateOriginal does not run find_immutable_patch_key (backend enforces immutability, so this is OK). Uncertainty driven by: no test for Email/copy with empty mailboxIds, no test for Mailbox/queryChanges total field.
Rust idiom confidence: 98% chance of no missed issue. Least confident flags: none. SetErrorType manual Display matches serde output — compiler enforces exhaustiveness on new variants.
